conventions.counts: Nonnegative integers except explicitly signed remaining quotas.
conventions.missing: null; never coerced to 0 or false
conventions.empty_denominator: 0.0 when the source is observed but has no eligible events
conventions.labels: Authored separately; labels, scenario names and matched rules are outside the model request.
conventions.graph: A synthetic observed neighborhood, not a production-complete entity graph.
conventions.entity_ids: Synthetic IDs exist only in source ledgers, not in the 200 model features.
